facts.title: simple crispy pan pizza
ingredients: 3/4 cup tomato sauce, prepared or homemade
6 ounces coarsely grated or torn mozzarella cheese (1 1/3 cup grated)
1/4 cup grated pecorino romano or parmesan cheese
Seasonings such as salt, pepper flakes, and dried oregano
facts.cook_time: Up to 2 to 3 hours, mostly hands off
facts.author: Deb Perelman
